AgentFlight

Change one input. See exactly what broke.

Replay a recorded tool call from a simulated incident, then change the time window and inspect the mismatch.

Read the AgentFlight case study↗ 🚀 Launch Mission Control↗
agentflight · replay
  1. recordedprometheus.query_metrics({ "service": "payment-api", "window": "15m" })
  2. replayprometheus.query_metrics({ "service": "payment-api", "window": "15m" })
  3. ✓ matchMatched the recorded tool call
  4. {
  "anomaly": true,
  "p99_latency_ms": 1840.0
}

A matching call returns the recorded response without calling the live tool.

  1. recordedprometheus.query_metrics({ "service": "payment-api", "window": "15m" })
  2. replayprometheus.query_metrics({ "service": "payment-api", "window": "30m" })
  3. ✗ failTrajectoryDivergenceError
  4. changed_values.window
- expected: "15m"
+ actual:   "30m"

The tool name still matches, but the changed argument is enough to fail the replay.
